mdClick describes the proposed state before commit and includes value, toggle, selected, href and target; mdChange follows commit and includes selected and value. originalEvent is omitted; activation.source identifies pointer, keyboard, accessibility or unknown native provenance.

AWCButtonAction dispatches actual native capture, target and bubble phases before defaults. preventDefault vetoes activation; stopPropagation retains same-scope listeners and stopImmediatePropagation stops them. Legacy onEvent receives final cancellation, propagationPath and native activation metadata. Native mdChange is noncancelable. Soft-disabled and loading controls keep native keyboard focus while suppressing activation.

type submit/reset uses the nearest AWCFormScope or an explicit owner registry. Cancelable mdSubmit/mdReset precede form effects; reset restores initial native bindings (OTP clears). Single-line Enter activates the first registered default submit button. AWCFormEncoding generates local UTF-8 URL-encoded data without network submission. target is passed to AWCURLRouter; raw nonempty href suppresses form actions.

groupTabindex implements the source null/0/-1 native focus contract: -1 skips sequential keyboard entry while retaining pointer, programmatic and accessibility actions. Hard-disabled excludes focus; soft-disabled/loading remain focusable and inert. Positive HTML tabindex sorting is not reproduced.

roleOverride supports native button/link/gridcell mappings with safe inference for empty/unknown roles. Gridcell selected state is independent of toggle. Width/minWidth/maxWidth/height/minHeight use source border-box sizing with minimum constraints winning conflicts; content remains centered and nowrap, with overflow clipped by the button shape. HTML_FORM.description: Actual native md-button submit/reset and text-field Enter use explicit form owners, all 13 source form-control families, source successful-value rules, ordered entries, validation, cancelable form events and reset bindings. Encoding is local and deterministic.

ICU patterns and Foundation URL parsing differ from browser JavaScript v-mode regex and URL parsing. UTF-16 length, common email/URL/number constraints, time bounds and native custom validators are supported; HTML dirty-value validity timing and every ValidityState flag are not reproduced.

Implicit submission uses native single-line onSubmit and the first registered default submit button. Source number-field commits then submits directly. Browser composition/deferred autocomplete selection and DOM tree-order algorithms are not emulated.

Source md-button requestSubmit does not contribute a submitter name/value. Native submit(submitter:) can carry explicit host metadata, without adding a source button entry. Native form events are mdSubmit/mdReset/mdInvalid, not browser SubmitEvent/ResetEvent objects.

CANCELABLE_EVENT.description: Actual md-button activation dispatches scoped native capture, target and bubble listeners with a stable path/target/current scope, explicit boundaries, synchronous cancellation and both propagation stops. Defaults follow accepted mdClick; noncancelable mdChange follows toggle commit. Legacy observations include final cancellation, native activation metadata and path.
limitations: These are explicit native scopes and boundaries, not DOM nodes, browser capture/retargeting, shadow roots or a browser composedPath. Boundary crossing is a native dispatch option; target identity is never silently retargeted.

Activation metadata identifies entry through native control, implicit-submit or programmatic action. It does not fabricate a DOM MouseEvent, raw OS event, modifier/middle-button semantics or browser isTrusted. Finished synchronous contexts cannot be canceled later.

DOM_GLOBAL.description: Observable native contexts resolve safe relative routes against current source history, implement self/blank/parent/top destinations and reusable named contexts, and provide local back navigation. Host approval precedes state changes; presentation callbacks observe committed state. The navigation demo renders local context and history state without external navigation.
limitations: Native contexts replace presentation destinations, not browser window/document objects, browsing-context groups, window.open, opener relationships, referrers, origin security or HTTP page loads. No network request or application launch occurs in the coordinator.

Named destinations are intentionally reusable native contexts. The source browser route uses noopener/noreferrer and may create fresh browsing contexts for named targets. Reserved native targets are case-insensitive; other underscore-prefixed names are rejected.

Relative routes use Foundation URL resolution and explicit native context base URLs; URL parsing is not claimed identical to the browser. Schemes are allowlisted and executable/file/data routes rejected. The default SwiftUI openURL fallback still delegates external presentation to the host and does not interpret browser target contexts.

SHADOW_DOM.description: An explicit native component tree owns nested content and rendering without accessing browser shadow roots.
limitations: This replaces component content ownership; it does not implement CSS shadow-tree encapsulation or DOM retargeting.

DOM_QUERY.description: Typed tree traversal finds native descendants by stable node ID or source tag without querying browser elements.
limitations: Supports explicit native ID/tag lookup, not arbitrary CSS selectors, live DOM collections or imperative HTMLElement references.

SLOT_INTROSPECTION.description: Native named-child lookup and dynamic fallback are used by md-button for default content, leading/trailing icons and loader.
limitations: Operates on declarative native child values; browser assignedElements, slotchange events and flattened DOM slot semantics do not exist.
